# Brightfront Studio

> Brightfront Studio is a web design studio in Brisbane, Australia (ABN 80 241 124 181) that designs and builds custom websites for small businesses, in Australia and worldwide. Fixed prices agreed up front, a first draft within days, and the domain, design and content always belong to the client.

## Services and prices (AUD, including GST for Australian clients)

- The Refresh, $1,500: redesign of an existing website, up to 5 pages, ready in about 2 weeks.
- The Full Build, $3,500: a custom website up to 8 pages, words written for the client, domain and email set up, 3 months of hosting. About 4 weeks.
- Websites for personal trainers and online coaches, $1,200: one page that replaces a Linktree, with packages, prices, results and an enquiry form. Live in 7 days.
- The Care Plan, $99 a month: hosting, security, backups and up to 5 changes a month. No lock-in.
- Get found on Google, $450: Google Business Profile, map listing and local search setup.
- Quoted to suit, with a fixed price agreed before work starts:
  - Real estate websites for agencies and agents: listings, appraisal requests, agent profiles, suburb pages and enquiry routing. https://brightfrontstudio.com/real-estate-websites.html
  - Expression of interest (EOI) forms: branded online forms for off-market sales and new projects, capturing offer, deposit, settlement, finance and conditions. https://brightfrontstudio.com/expression-of-interest-forms.html
  - Property e-brochures: online listing brochures with full-screen photos, floor plan, features and inspection times. https://brightfrontstudio.com/property-e-brochures.html
  - Shopify stores and themes: custom themes, store setup and migration from other platforms. https://brightfrontstudio.com/shopify-stores.html
  - Custom branding: logo, colour palette, type and a one-page brand guide. https://brightfrontstudio.com/branding.html

## How it works

1. The client fills in a short online planner (or books a free 15-minute call) and shares their logo, photos and brand colours.
2. They see a real draft of their website within days and ask for changes.
3. They approve it and it goes live on their own domain. Half is paid to start, half on launch day.

## Good fit for

Local and small businesses that want a website that looks like their brand rather than a template: cafés, trades, salons, clinics, real estate agents, shops, personal trainers and coaches. Also business owners who don't want to deal with the tech themselves (see the done-for-you service).
